notes: The selection preserves original feature properties and geometries; exact city-center or mine-site precision is not asserted.
Use geometry.coordinates for display. Some original longitude/latitude attributes differ slightly from the actual Point geometry, notably Durban.
Middelburg is ambiguous: selected the Mpumalanga feature, excluding the Eastern Cape feature with the same name.
Natural Earth uses Orange Free State in some adm1name attributes; normalize to Free State for display and preserve source property separately.
Mbombela has namepar=Nelspruit; Bhisho has namealt=Bisho; Polokwane has historic Pietersburg alias.
Natural Earth featurecla includes legacy/incorrect capital labels. Establish current governmental roles from the government source, not the featurecla field.
Natural Earth population fields are approximate historic urban/metro estimates, not current municipal or Census populations. Do not surface these numbers as current population facts.
Missing requested towns are not guessed. Use verified province locators for relevant mining entities until site-specific coordinates can be sourced.
